title: 18th Sitting of first Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/18/1/2025).
Approval of the minutes of four previous sittings (minutes Nos. 14/1/2025 to 17/1/2025).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's request for Majlis consent to appoint the Chair of the Privatization and Corporatization Board, under Article 9(a) and (b) of the Act on Privatization, Corporatization, Monitoring and Evaluation of State Businesses (Law No. 3/2013), is sent to the relevant standing committee.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nomination of a non-resident ambassador to the Republic of Azerbaijan, under Article 115(d) of the Constitution and Article 14 of the Foreign Service Act (Law No. 20/2021), is sent to the relevant standing committee.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nominee for appointment to the Civil Service Commission, under Article 180(b) of the Constitution and Article 13 of the Civil Service Act (Law No. 5/2007), is sent to the relevant standing committee.

Preliminary debate on the resolution submitted by Hulhumalé South MP Dr Ahmed Shamheed to ascertain members' views on actions by the government and the Maldives Monetary Authority that go against the Constitution, related laws and the 2025 state budget passed by the Majlis.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting approved old minutes, sent three presidential nominations (Privatization Board chair, Azerbaijan ambassador, Civil Service Commission member) to committees, and opened debate on a resolution criticising government and MMA actions against the 2025 budget.
